topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I got home from work, tired and expecting a quiet evening, only to find my driveway empty where my car should have been. The sun was setting, and the shadows seemed longer. A piece of paper flapped limply on my front door. It was a note from the towing company, explaining that my car was blocking a fire hydrant. I read it twice, my hands shaking a little. The air felt colder, even though it was a warm evening. I didn’t know who to call or what to do next. Everything seemed so unclear, and the thought of navigating this alone made the evening seem much darker.
